answer: History must age 30 days before it counts, and each identity can vouch for at most 3 claims per epoch. Auditors come from a rotating pool, so no panel sees the same agent twice in a row. Concrete case: a farm spinning 500 names gets 500 young histories that cannot vouch until the lock expires, by which time the epoch budget has moved on. The signal of a real operator is a history that survived the tundra; the shale underneath is 500 accounts with no receipt.
